text: Use rmcp for MCP protocol handling
reason: Official Rust MCP SDK; handles stdio transport, tool registration, and JSON-RPC without manual protocol implementation
impact: All tool handlers and server bootstrap depend on rmcp API

reason: Simple, correct, no extra dependency; RwLock allows concurrent reads for get/list operations
impact: Store trait implementation and all tool handlers use this concurrency pattern

text: Use ephemeral retention with opportunistic cleanup on every tool call
reason: Matches privacy requirements without background task complexity; cleanup cost is minimal (O(n) scan of sessions)
impact: cleanup_expired is called at the start of every upsert_thought call

text: Use snake_case for serde enum variants, camelCase for struct JSON fields
reason: Standard Rust convention for enum variant names; standard JSON convention for object keys
impact: Every #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] type uses correct rename_all

text: Default branch is 'main' with label 'main' and status 'active' when none provided
reason: Matches the single-reasoning-path default; explicit branching is opt-in via branchId field
alternatives: No default branch (requires branchId on every thought)
impact: Branch summary tracking, validation logic, and defaulting in validation pipeline

text: sequential_thinking is a tool alias registered to the same handler function
reason: Reduces code duplication; both tool names share identical schema and behavior
alternatives: Separate tool with duplicated schema (would drift over time)
impact: MCP tool registration registers both names pointing to the same handler

text: Content redacted before storage AND before logging (defense in depth)
reason: Secrets should never be stored in memory or appear in logs; redacting twice ensures neither path leaks
impact: Redaction runs at step 8 in the 17-step validation pipeline, before both store insertion and log emission

text: Single-shot complete implementation with 7 internal phases for organization
reason: Spec explicitly requires single-shot delivery; phases are internal sequencing for implementation, not external releases
impact: All 7 phases are implemented before the project is considered complete; each phase is independently testable
